### Appalled but Productive
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/appalled-but-productive
Passage: Daniel 8:27
Points:
- Daniel was overwhelmed and made physically ill by the vision of coming suffering.
- Despite being sick and appalled, Daniel got up and resumed his work for the king.
- Ministry and life often bring distressing news, yet believers must faithfully carry on.
- Believers find strength to endure by knowing they are deeply loved by God.
- Resting in God's eternal love removes fear, enabling us to remain productive in a broken world.
